Direction A: five Mist variations

Each variation keeps the soft fade and TRIGO colours of direction A and changes one or two things: the fade, the heading font, how screenshots are shown, or the contrast. Each shows four slides from the 7-slide outline: cover, an app overview, modules, and Get started with QR codes and the PWA note.

Pick one, or mix parts. For example, the A3 cover with the A1 slides.

A1 MistA2 HorizonA3 Sage MistA4 Duo MistA5 Deep Mist

The direction you picked, unchanged, as the reference. A diagonal navy-to-white fade with a faint green glow in the top right, desktop screenshots stacked.

A2 · Horizon

The fade runs top to bottom like a morning sky. Screenshots are larger and rise from the bottom edge. Headings use Outfit at a lighter weight, and module tiles drop their boxes for more air.

A5 · Deep Mist

Starts in TRIGO navy and fades to white. Titles sit in white on the navy, content on the light part. More contrast than A1, so it holds up on meeting-room projectors that wash out pale colours.
